verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that the Cursor GitHub app, which grants Bugbot its repository access, can be installed on 'Selected repositories' rather than all of them. That is a coarse form of least-privilege scoping for the agent, but it is not issuing API credentials. missing for 10: any documented way to issue API keys or tokens for an agent, permission scopes or least-privilege roles on such credentials, credential rotation or revocation, and independent corroboration.
